items.description: Tracking company passwords in spreadsheets can leave IT administrators unaware of weak, reused, or compromised credentials stored and shared outside approved systems. items.title: Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
items.description: A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled. items.title: The Path to AI Autonomy in the SOC
items.description: Security leaders are about to hand AI agents a lot more authority.
